The company exhibits a strong, liquid, and well-capitalized balance sheet characterized by a very high current ratio of 3.37x, a low debt-to-equity profile (total liabilities of $5.24B are nearly matched by $5.04B in equity), and solid cumulative profitability with $2.50B in retained earnings. Operationally, it is profitable with a 40% gross margin and a respectable 14% operating margin ($704M operating income on $5.21B revenue), though its overall profitability metrics are moderate relative to its large asset base ($10.82B). This combination of excellent liquidity, conservative leverage, and stable operating profitability supports a solid investment-grade profile in the upper-medium grade.

DECISION: A-
